card.name: Endings of split long words and brand names
card.fires_on: The final piece of a longer word that has been split up, such as the -ality in embryo-lethality, the BAL in the brand name LYBALVI, or the A in LABA. It also fires on -able in livable.

modes.description: The middle or last piece of the brand name LYBALVI or of the abbreviation LABA.

modes.label: General word ending
modes.description: The -able ending of an ordinary word in web text.
modes.example: adequate caloric intake, and liv<<able>> housing.
